description: This file implements an asynchronous HTTP connection manager using aiohttp, including session pooling, connection health monitoring, metrics collection, and support for batch requests within the AgentField SDK.

classes.name: ConnectionMetrics
classes.description: Tracks metrics related to connection pool usage and request statistics.

classes.name: ConnectionHealth
classes.description: Represents the health status of the connection pool, including failure counts and last error.

classes.name: ConnectionManager
classes.description: Manages aiohttp sessions and connection pooling, providing request handling, health checks, and background maintenance tasks.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ConnectionManager with optional configuration.

methods.name: __aenter__
methods.description: Enables use of the class as an async context manager, starting the session.

methods.name: __aexit__
methods.description: Closes the session when exiting the async context.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Creates the aiohttp session and connector, and starts background tasks.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the session, connector, and cancels background tasks.

methods.name: get_session
methods.description: Provides an async context for using the aiohttp session.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs a single HTTP request, tracking metrics and health.

methods.name: health_check
methods.description: Performs a health check on the connection pool.

methods.name: _health_check_loop
methods.description: Background task periodically checking connection health.

methods.name: _cleanup_loop
methods.description: Background task periodically updating metrics and performing cleanup.

methods.name: is_closed
methods.description: Property indicating if the connection manager is closed.
